# `dashboard/routes/logs.ts`

Module overview: Provides routing and filtering utilities for the dashboard logs view. This module contains helpers for evaluating whether log entries match a given set of filter criteria.

---

## Functions

### `matchesFilter`

> **Not exported.** This function is internal to the module and cannot be imported directly.

Evaluates whether a single log entry satisfies all of the provided filter criteria. Returns `true` if the entry matches every specified filter, or `false` if any filter condition is not met.

#### Signature

```typescript
function matchesFilter(
  entry: LogEntry,
  filters: {
    levels?: Set<string>;
    component?: string;
    taskId?: string;
    search?: string;
  }
): boolean
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `entry` | `LogEntry` | The log entry to evaluate against the provided filters. |
| `filters` | `object` | An object describing the filter criteria to apply. All fields are optional; omitting a field means that criterion is not applied. |
| `filters.levels` | `Set<string>` *(optional)* | A set of log level strings (e.g., `"info"`, `"warn"`, `"error"`). The entry must match one of the levels in the set. |
| `filters.component` | `string` *(optional)* | Filters entries by the component that produced them. The entry must match this component string. |
| `filters.taskId` | `string` *(optional)* | Filters entries by a specific task identifier. The entry must be associated with this task ID. |
| `filters.search` | `string` *(optional)* | A free-text search string. The entry must contain this string in its searchable fields. |

#### Returns

`boolean` — `true` if the log entry satisfies all specified filter criteria; `false` otherwise.

#### Example

```typescript
const entry: LogEntry = {
  level: "warn",
  component: "scheduler",
  taskId: "task-42",
  message: "Retrying failed job",
};

const filters = {
  levels: new Set(["warn", "error"]),
  component: "scheduler",
  search: "retry",
};

const result = matchesFilter(entry, filters);
// result => true
```
